competitors.name: Walmart
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported Numerator data showing Gen Z shoppers added 77 million Walmart trips worth $3.4 billion over the 12 months ended July 31, including nearly $1.2 billion in beverages, snacks, candy and frozen foods. The same report said Boomer in-store CPG spending fell $6.2 billion while lower-income shoppers shifted $7.8 billion of spend away from stores and $7.3 billion online.

competitors.name: Target
competitors.action: Grocery Dive reported Target's Q2 2026 food and beverage sales grew 7.2% year over year to just under $6 billion. Target also reset almost half of its center-store grocery assortment, added fresh produce space, and expanded high-growth areas such as international foods, snacks, protein bars, meat sticks and better-for-you snacks.

competitors.name: Kroger / Ukrop's Homestyle Foods
competitors.action: Supermarket News reported Kroger is expanding branded Ukrop's prepared-foods sections in Mid-Atlantic stores, including grab-and-go baked goods, salads and prepared meals. A new Midlothian, Virginia, Kroger opening in early September will replace an in-store Starbucks with a Ukrop's department.

trends.topic: Gen Z and higher-income shoppers driving Walmart frozen-adjacent CPG growth
trends.magnitude: Gen Z added nearly $1.2B in Walmart beverage, snack, candy and frozen-food spend over 12 months; higher-income shoppers added $3.6B in the same categories.
trends.context: Frozen and snack-adjacent growth is shifting toward younger and higher-income Walmart shoppers even as legacy Boomer and lower-income in-store traffic weakens. Premium frozen brands should watch Walmart as both a value channel and a discovery channel for younger households.

trends.topic: Target repositioning grocery as a discovery-led traffic engine
trends.magnitude: Food and beverage sales rose 7.2% year over year in Q2 2026 after less than 1% growth in the year-earlier period.
trends.context: Target is using center-store resets and space shifts toward international foods, snacks and fresh produce to strengthen grocery trips. Frozen pizza competitors selling through Target will be judged against broader discovery, better-for-you and meal-solution expectations.

trends.topic: Prepared foods expanding as restaurant trade-down competition
trends.magnitude: 38% of retailers in SN's 2026 Retailer Expectations Survey planned to expand deli/prepared foods; 66% planned more grab-and-go or prepacked foods.
trends.context: Kroger's branded Ukrop's departments show supermarkets leaning harder into prepared meal occasions. Frozen pizza needs a clear at-home value and quality role as shoppers compare freezer options with increasingly prominent store-prepared meals.

breaking.headline: Boomers and Lower-Income Households Pull Back From Walmart: Report
breaking.impact: Walmart's frozen-adjacent CPG gains are increasingly concentrated in Gen Z and higher-income shoppers, while legacy value shoppers shift channel behavior.

breaking.headline: Target’s turnaround gains steam as grocery sales power ahead
breaking.impact: Target's grocery reset and strong food/beverage growth raise the merchandising bar for premium frozen and better-for-you meal products.

breaking.headline: Kroger expands Ukrop’s prepared-foods sections
breaking.impact: Regional branded prepared-food departments are becoming stronger competition for frozen meal and pizza occasions.
